# CodeWithAbby — Web Developer in Delhi | Custom Business Websites

> CodeWithAbby is a boutique custom web development studio founded by Syed Abbas Ali (Abby), based in Delhi, India. We engineer high-performance React & Next.js business websites, custom web applications, e-commerce platforms, and WebGL experiences for businesses in Delhi, across India, and globally.

## About the Studio

CodeWithAbby was founded by Syed Abbas Ali — an independent full-stack web developer and software engineer based in New Delhi, India. The studio specializes in custom business website development, bespoke frontend engineering, technical SEO, and sub-second performance optimization. Every project is hand-coded using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. No templates. No page builders. No outsourcing.

The studio serves clients across Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, across India, as well as international businesses in the United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Canada, and Australia.

## Core Services

- **Business Website Development** — High-converting, authoritative business websites engineered with React and Next.js.
- **Custom Web Development** — Bespoke full-stack web architectures, APIs, and database-backed web applications.
- **Website Design & UI/UX Architecture** — Editorial-grade, high-contrast digital interfaces that build brand trust and drive inquiries.
- **E-commerce Website Development** — Custom headless e-commerce storefronts, sub-second product filtering, and streamlined checkouts.
- **Website Redesign & Performance Optimization** — Transforming slow legacy websites into sub-800ms high-speed platforms with 90+ Core Web Vitals scores.
- **Technical SEO & Schema Architecture** — Deep semantic HTML, JSON-LD structured data (Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, Breadcrumb), and search engine indexing.
- **Creative WebGL & 3D Web Experiences** — Three.js-powered interactive canvases, kinetic typography, and immersive brand moments.

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React 19, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, TanStack Router
- 3D & Animation: Three.js, WebGL, GLSL Shaders, GSAP, Framer Motion
- Backend & Deployment: Node.js, REST APIs, Vercel Edge CDN, PostgreSQL
- Performance & Standards: Core Web Vitals, JSON-LD, Semantic HTML5, WCAG AA Accessibility

## Real Client Case Studies & Proof of Work

1. **ALP Buildcon** (`https://alpbuildcon.com/`) — PropTech & Infrastructure website. Next.js platform with lead pipeline routing, mobile speed improved from 8.0s to 1.3s, resulting in +140% qualified project inquiries.
2. **Zainca Luxury Store** — Headless E-Commerce storefront. Custom Next.js product catalog and checkout replacing bloated WooCommerce, delivering 0.9s load times and 3.2x sales lift.
3. **Mainframe Studio** — B2B SaaS & Analytics platform. Dark luxury interface with interactive 3D WebGL preview and 99/100 Lighthouse performance.
4. **Dentiva Clinic** — Healthcare & Dental platform with streamlined appointment booking and responsive mobile design.

## How Engagements Work

1. **Submit a Brief:** Client submits goals, requirements, and timeline via the Contact page.
2. **Discovery & Strategy:** Direct consultation with Syed Abbas Ali to lock scope, architecture, and milestones.
3. **Engineering & Live Staging:** Bespoke code development with live preview links at every milestone.
4. **Launch & Code Ownership:** Production deployment with 100% source code transfer, repository access, and 30 days of post-launch technical support. Typical turnaround is 6 to 14 business days.

**Q: Who works on the code?**
